artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact verification of the finite proof core and a direct scan through one million.
Deterministic verification output for the multiples of four through 48 and the direct scan through one million.

limitations: The theorem is specific to the [2,3]-near-perfect specialization; it does not settle general near F_k-perfect or [k,l]-near-perfect numbers. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older divisor-sum literature under unrelated terminology.
record_title: Near F-perfect numbers do not exist
scientific_context: The near F-perfect equation sigma_2(n)-n^2-d^2=3n has no solutions with d a positive proper divisor. A reciprocal-divisor reformulation reduces the proof to elementary positivity and a twelve-integer finite core.
